summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: @onereach/si-dropdown-simple@0.4.5 declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs on every `npm install`. setup.mjs is Obfuscator.io-style code (hex-named identifiers, per-function string maps) that downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, unzips it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and execFileSyncs Bun against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB heavily obfuscated file using a rotated string-array decoder (WV8StW push/shift on a ~1000-element mixed hex/string array) whose real behavior cannot be inspected without executing it. The package presents itself as a Vue dropdown component, which has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time or to execute an obfuscated local script under it. Selecting Bun as the interpreter also bypasses Node-based install-time scanning of the executed payload.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
